title: Commissioned works
intro1: The Förderverein programme run by the Brandenburg State Orchestra Frankfurt (Oder) fosters the creation of new music: by awarding composition commissions to contemporary composers, we support the orchestra in bringing vibrant new works directly to the stage.
intro2: Commissioned works are a commitment to the present: they ensure that the Brandenburg State Orchestra not only preserves the great legacy of the Classical period, but also plays an active part in shaping today’s musical history.
werk1_titel: Georg Breinschmid – Old Viennese Expressive Dances
werk1_text: Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach Concert Hall, Frankfurt (Oder) – in collaboration with the Mecklenburg-Vorpommern Festival. The Viennese double bassist and composer Georg Breinschmid has written a concerto that playfully blurs the boundaries between classical music, jazz and folk music.
werk2_text: Berlin Philharmonic. This work by the Leipzig-based composer and pianist Steffen Schleiermacher was composed during the Beethoven Year and received its world premiere by the Brandenburg State Orchestra Frankfurt (Oder) – a dialogue between the present day and the legacy of Ludwig van Beethoven.
infobox: **Funding from Förderverein BSOF:** Commissioned compositions are made possible by membership fees and donations. Every membership directly contributes to the creation and performance of new music.
mitmachen: As a member of Förderverein, you will enable BSOF to continue commissioning and premiering new works in the future. Become part of this vibrant musical history.
